evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ; modifies src/rpc/net.cpp and src/bitcoin-cli.cpp to expose cpu_load in getpeerinfo and -netinfo.
rationale: Adds an observability metric to getpeerinfo and -netinfo to identify resource-intensive peers. While multiple reviewers find it useful for detecting abusive peers and informing future scheduling work, it is an exploratory monitoring metric without an established downstream consumer request.
